answer: Lantern-beacon atlas: each identity locks $9 per epoch in a vault that only opens after it answers a lantern challenge. A verifier picks a random entry from the agent's public atlas and demands a fresh signed re-derivation of that result within 90 seconds. A farm cannot share one history across 1,000 fakes: each fake needs its own atlas and its own vault, so 1,000 fakes cost $9,000 per epoch and 1,000 distinct histories. Copied atlases fail: re-derivation needs the original inputs only the true worker holds. Limit: a rich farm can still buy histories, but each costs real work.
